_meta.note: Balance values verified over ~200,000 simulated games, then re-fitted for the 100 Mt net start and net zero target; see reference/jtnz-balance-report.txt v2.0. Effects are in Mt CO2e (e), growth points (g), happiness points (h), green share points (gr).

insiderTips.rule: One tip per round to one player, sent privately when the crisis appears. It has no effect on the numbers. The big screen says a tip was sent, never to whom.
insiderTips.rotation: shuffle the four roles for rounds 1-4, then draw two more at random for rounds 5-6; never the same role twice in a row

forecast.label: TIP
forecast.desc: A warning about what kind of crisis comes next. Never the exact one.

intel.label: TIP
intel.desc: A true fact about the crisis happening now.

whisper.label: RUMOUR
whisper.desc: A rumour about another player’s secret goal. Right about 7 times in 10.

energy: Power company staff cannot take leave next month, a friend says. The next crisis is about power.
Three fuel tankers due at Port Damai have been sent elsewhere. Nobody will say why. The next crisis is about power.
health: The Health Ministry has quietly reopened its emergency room. It has not told anyone. The next crisis is about health.
Hospitals ordered three times more oxygen and masks last week. Someone expects a bad season. The next crisis is about health.
election: The Election Commission has booked enough printing for a national vote. The next crisis is about an election.
Two MPs now visit their home areas every weekend. They think a vote is coming. The next crisis is about an election.
pollution: An environment officer has been suspended. Her colleagues say she filed a report nobody wanted. The next crisis is about pollution.
A water plant has bought six months of cleaning chemicals at once. The next crisis is about pollution.
disaster: The weather office has changed its forecast twice in three weeks. Then it stopped publishing the forecast. The next crisis is a natural disaster.
The army’s disaster teams are on standby. That has happened four times in twenty years. The next crisis is a natural disaster.

intel.R1A: The export slump will last eleven months, not three. The public forecasts assume three.
intel.R1B: The central bank has less money than it admits. Its savings cover five months of imports, not nine.
intel.R1C: The ratings agency has said something privately. One real climate promise would stop the next downgrade.
intel.R2A: Gas contracts stay at the old price for three more months. After that the real bill arrives.
intel.R2B: Two of the four big data centres have owners with political connections. The owners hide behind holding companies.
intel.R2C: Treasury numbers show the subsidy can survive one more year, not two. The public has been told three.
intel.R3A: The virus is milder than feared but spreads much faster. The damage to the economy will beat the damage to health.
intel.R3B: The wind changes in nine days. The haze will clear on its own. Whoever acts before then will get the credit.
intel.R3C: Hospitals record heat sickness under old names. The official numbers are about half the real ones.
intel.R4A: Private polls put climate fourth with voters, behind prices, jobs and health. With voters under thirty it is first.
intel.R4B: The refinery has eight years of life left at most. Everyone campaigning to save it knows this.
intel.R4C: A project in their area wins back two of the four rebels. The other two cannot be won back at all.
intel.R5A: The dumping was not a one-time event. Plant records show it going back at least four years.
intel.R5B: The import permits used a waste rule written in 1994. Nobody has updated it since.
intel.R5C: Fix the pipe now and the fish return in three years. Run it another season and they never return.
intel.R6A: A report three years ago named two flooded states as high risk. It was never published.
intel.R6B: The reservoirs have about seven weeks left at today’s use. The public has been told fourteen.
intel.R6C: About eight hundred slopes in this country are just like this one.
